name: DraggableUIPanel
src_typeComment: Drop on a UI panel (typically a "title bar" child, but works directly on the panel too) to make it drag-to-move — movable HUD elements, debug/inspector-style floating windows.

src_serialized.name: panelToMove
src_serialized.tooltip: The panel that actually moves. Defaults to this object's own RectTransform if left empty — assign a different one if this script sits on a title-bar child instead of the panel itself.

src_serialized.name: clampToParent
src_serialized.tooltip: Keeps the panel fully within its parent's bounds while dragging.
